hero.title: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step
hero.subtitle: A collaborative platform for building and improving decks — powered by a novel SRS scheduling algorithm, AI-assisted quality checks, and adaptive review.

about.title: About Rete
about.description: Rete is a smart flashcard app powered by spaced repetition science. It optimizes your review schedule so you spend less time studying while retaining more. Whether you're learning languages, preparing for exams, or mastering new skills, Rete adapts to your memory patterns for maximum efficiency.

community.title: Community Decks
community.description: Create, share, and improve decks together — quality compounds over time instead of drifting stale.

algorithm.title: Novel Algorithm
algorithm.description: A scheduling algorithm built to address legacy SRS pain points — steep setup, review backlogs that snowball, and a single forgetting-curve model applied to every card.

ui.title: Intuitive Design
ui.description: An intuitive, clean, modern interface that makes studying a pleasure, not a chore.

ai.title: AI-Assisted Quality
ai.description: AI reviews decks for accuracy and clarity — with human verification before any change goes live.

step1.title: Create or Import a Deck
step1.description: Build your own deck from scratch or import an existing one from the community.

step2.title: Build a Learning Habit
step2.description: Review a manageable daily queue and keep a steady rhythm — sustainable learning, not last-minute cramming.

step3.title: Track Progress
step3.description: Watch your knowledge grow over time with detailed statistics and progress tracking.

cta.title: Start Learning Today
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of learners who are already using Rete to remember more, for longer.
cta.note: iOS is available through TestFlight beta. Android is on Google Play for Internal Testing.
